title: Among the few worshippers
html_source: There are only a few worshippers – few that take on such devotion like Stephen.

anchor.prefix: of its every moment of thought or action for the intentions of the sovereign pontiff and with an early mass. The raw morning air whetted his resolute piety; and often as he knelt
anchor.suffix: at the sidealtar, following with his interleaved prayerbook the murmur of the priest, he glanced up for an instant towards the vested figure standing in the gloom between the two
